C9000109.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 109 (Integer multiplication below $`n\log n`$.; papers: Integer multiplication below n log n; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: Manuscript thm:main: exact n-bit multiplication on one fixed finite-alphabet finite-tape Turing machine in O(n (lg n)^(1-2^-182)) worst-case time. Not certified by this finite-network mission.

C_STREAMS.statement: Manuscript lem:elementary-streams and lem:ordered-affine-streams, including O(V) fixed-tape ordering, descriptors and cleanup. Outside finite-core certification.

C_INTERCHANGE.statement: Manuscript lem:matrix-shear, prop:power-interchange and lem:chunk-swap: charge all addressing, padding, arbitrary-scratch routing and recursive fixed-tape costs in the O(V u^tau) interchange bound.

C_LAYERS.statement: Manuscript prop:simultaneous-layer: simultaneous numerical butterflies with all packing, precision, ordering, descriptor and parameter hypotheses.

C_SYNTHETIC.statement: Manuscript lem:synthetic-characters, lem:synthetic-transform-cost, lem:signed-ring-product and prop:synthetic-convolution, with their analytic error and tape-cost hypotheses.

C_RESAMPLING.statement: Manuscript lem:no-sort-resampling, lem:tensor-resampling and lem:chirp-permutation: source/target parameter existence, contractions, errors, retained ordering and all costs.

C_EXACT_RECOVERY.statement: Manuscript section 08: admissible explicit parameters, coefficient error strictly below 1/2, exact carries and all exponent margins.

C_KNOWN_BASELINE.statement: Known external baseline, not a new result: Harvey and van der Hoeven (2021), integer multiplication in O(n log n) in the multitape Turing machine model.

C_FINITE_CORE.statement: Complete all-input finite-network contract of section 03: arbitrary scratch, signed bank exchange, actual comparable nondegenerate labels, full ranks, routed shear and phase corrections on every role and every positive column count.

C_UNIFORM_FINITE.statement: For every integer h>=40 the same three-stage triple networks satisfy the complete all-input interfaces, with v=binom(h,3), N=v^3, m=h^3, I=3v^2, W=2N+I(vz+c), L=Ich, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, both strictly below Wm. This is a uniform finite-network theorem, not a multiplication complexity claim.

C_SCALAR.statement: Manuscript lem:scalar-motifs for arbitrary auxiliary inputs in F_2 and Z[i,1/2], including the reversed second-stage schedule and route signs.

C_LABELS.statement: Manuscript eq:motif-labels and lem:motif-residuals: every actual edge has comparable nondegenerate endpoints and every nonzero binary residual has an orthonormal basis.

C_RANK.statement: Derive the full residual-rank budget from the actual gate subspaces, including scratch endpoints, all stages, and N rank-one negative rational source corrections.

C_RATIONAL.statement: Manuscript prop:bit-motif-interface: every routed endpoint matrix difference is I_m and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m.

C_PHASE.statement: Manuscript prop:complex-motif-interface: residual kernels, all-role signed routing, and the 27k phase endpoint corrections give C^(tensor mk) for all integers k>=1, with s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c.

C_STRUCTURAL_LEAN.statement: Kernel-checked structural algebra underlying the finite-network proof, with faithful all-input quantifiers rather than only numerical budget inequalities.
